question: What mantra form results from adding the haṃsa seed at the end of the trikūṭa?
premises: The haṃsa seed is placed at the end of the trikūṭa.
This addition produces a specific form.
inference: Adding the haṃsa seed at the end of the trikūṭa yields the seventeen-syllable form.
plain_english: When the haṃsa seed is placed at the end of the trikūṭa, it becomes the seventeen-syllable form.
